about_the_game:
Welcome to Throne Alone, a merciless, physics-based rage platformer set inside a mysterious desert testing ground. With no limbs, no wheels, and no explanation, you must hurl, strafe, and fall your way through a brutal vertical gauntlet built to break you.

The Supervisor is watching.

A glowing blue face etched into ancient walls taunts your every move. This is The Supervisor—your ever-present judge, commentator, and tormentor. He mocks your failures, questions your purpose, and offers nothing but cryptic remarks and biting sarcasm.

Why are you here? What is being tested? He’s not telling.

You are the Toilet 

Realistic physics and momentum-based movement. Launch yourself with precision—or suffer humiliating setbacks.

Every Jump Matters

No retries, no easy saves. Control is everything, and the desert shows no mercy.

Anubis' Beacons 

Reach these ancient statues to mark rare, one-time respawn points. Fail to reach one? Enjoy the long fall back.

Reactive Supervisor Commentary 

He watches. He critiques. He insults. And maybe… he reveals a deeper mystery.

A Harsh Desert Labyrinth

Climb crumbling ruins and surreal structures baked under a scorching sky. Every step forward is earned.

Inspired by the Best(or Worst?)

Built in the spirit of punishing games like Jump King, Getting Over It, Alt+F4, and A Difficult Game About Climbing.

What’s Really Going On?

Why a toilet? Why the desert? Why is a smug floating face talking to you?

The answers are somewhere… at the top. Probably.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 • AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD HD 7850 / Intel UHD 620 (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 • AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM, DirectX 12)

short_description: Throne Alone is a cursed physics platformer where gravity hates you, progress is pain, and a blue floating face roasts your every moment.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
